newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco tenders for 30,000 tonnes barley.
newsitem.headline: Morocco tenders for 30,000 tonnes barley.

text.p: Grain traders said on Tuesday Morocco was tendering the same day for 30,000 tonnes of feed barley to be delivered between August 22 and 31.
The tender is for barley of optional origin, they said.
Morocco earlier called off a tender for about 130,000 tonnes of optional-origin soft wheat for August and September shipment, saying prices previously offered had been too high.
But a Moroccan trader said the country was expected to return to the market with another tender on Wednesday.
Wheat prices stumbled overnight and were indicated a few cents per bushel lower in electronic trading ahead of the Chicago futures opening.
